property_summary: For any actor and any block, locking a guess and calling settle() at the target block itself must not consume/reset the guess (reference reverts, guess stays locked, so a second lockInGuess still fails); the mutant settles at the target block, clearing the guess so the actor can lock in again.
change_summary: Change the timing check from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing settle to be called at the target block itself (resetting state instead of reverting).
